decode_last.stopped: monthly call budget reserved for inventory sweeps

coverage.note: Read through the owner's own browser, not from the cloud: every US dealer sitemap and each matching listing page (VIN, transmission, factory option codes, CPO, fees). finder.porsche.com answers GitHub's servers with a bot-check page that is not bypassed, so the daily cloud run cannot refresh these listings; they are as of the capture time shown here until the next browser capture.

Licensed API for nationwide used dealer inventory (Porsche dealers and independents), swept daily in three model-year buckets. It carries VIN, price, mileage, colours, CPO flag and photo links, but no factory option list, so front lift and accident history need the seller's documentation.

Paid per-VIN lookup, run once for each car that passes every other hard requirement, within a monthly call budget. For most of these cars the decode is assembled from the dealer's listed options, not an OEM build record, so a front-lift option it finds counts as seller-documented and a decode without one proves nothing unless it lists ten or more options.
Cars.com disallows automated access in robots.txt and offers no public inventory API. Dealer stock that appears there is reached through the MarketCheck feed instead.
No automated access permitted to the sites themselves. An official CarGurus connector exists for Claude and can be used for manual cross-checks.

coverage.source: Bring a Trailer / Cars & Bids / PCarMarket
coverage.note: Completed-sale prices are entered in config/manual_sales.csv with a public URL per sale; the sites are not crawled.
